programmes.d: A gunman (Randolph Scott) rides into Sundown for a showdown with the big shot (John Carroll) he blames for stealing his wife.
A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.
Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.
A cowboy discards his chaps and saddle for a suit and tie when he travels to the big city to investigate a produce racket that has been ruining his father's lettuce shipments.

programmes.t: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
programmes.d: Outlaw Billy (Scott Brady) courts a rancher's daughter (Betta St. John) and is hunted by lawman Pat Garrett (James Griffith).
A posse led by an alcoholic sheriff pursues the Drune family after they rob a wealthy rancher. Several days later, the Drunes are all dead, the sheriff is wounded, and the money has disappeared.
A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.
An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.
A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.
Two guys (Rod Cameron, Wayne Morris) find stages hijacked for sale to Rebels.
Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.
A woman writer (Karen Valentine) and a cavalry widow (Sandra Will) seek Billy the Kid.
An Indian girl (Kathryn Grant) and a land agent's daughter (Felicia Farr) save a part-Indian cattle rancher (Guy Madison) from vigilantes.
A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.
A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.
The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.
